title: 0 A.D. — Alpha 27 “Agni” trailer
summary: The release trailer for a free, open-source strategy game of ancient civilisations.
description:
Wildfire Games’ trailer for Alpha 27 “Agni” of 0 A.D. Empires Ascendant, a free and open-source real-time strategy game about ancient civilisations. It walks through new features, maps and game modes, with stylised ancient-warfare battle scenes (no gore).

Creative Commons (BY-SA) demonstration media, shown unaltered; not a Monumental Original.
